name: Archives Security Center Insight
description: Archives Security Center Insight Archives a Security Center insight for an account, removing it from the active insights list while preserving historical data. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/{issue_id}/dismiss
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/{issue_id}/dismiss
Archives a Security Center insight for an account, removing it from the active insights list while preserving historical data.
Required: account_id (path); issue_id (path); body (body)

name: Retrieves Account Audit Log
description: Retrieves Account Audit Log Lists audit log entries for all Security Center insights in the account, showing changes to insight status and classification. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/audit-log
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/audit-log
Lists audit log entries for all Security Center insights in the account, showing changes to insight status and classification.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: per_page (query) — Number of results per page.; cursor (query) — Opaque cursor for pagination. Use the cursor value from result_info of the previous response.; field_changed (query) — Filter by the field that was changed.; changed_by (query) — Filter by the actor that made the change.; since (query) — Filter entries changed at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).; before (query) — Filter entries changed before this timestamp (RFC 3339).; order (query) — Sort order for results. Use 'asc' for oldest first or 'desc' for newest first.

name: Get Recent Account Scans
description: Get Recent Account Scans Returns the most recent on-demand scans for the account, up to a maximum of 5. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/scans
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/scans
Returns the most recent on-demand scans for the account, up to a maximum of 5. Each scan includes its ID, start time, and current status. This includes both account-wide and zone-scoped scans. Also returns quota information showing how many scans have been used and how many remain in the current 24-hour window.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Retrieves Account State
description: Retrieves Account State Returns account-level Security Center state: whether scans are enabled for the account and whether the account was recently reactivated from a dormant state. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/state
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/state
Returns account-level Security Center state: whether scans are enabled for the account and whether the account was recently reactivated from a dormant state.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Retrieves Security Center Insight Context
description: Retrieves Security Center Insight Context Returns the full context payload for an insight. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/{issue_id}/context
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/{issue_id}/context
Returns the full context payload for an insight. This endpoint is used for insights with large payloads that are not included inline in the list response.
Required: account_id (path); issue_id (path)

name: Start On-Demand Account Scan
description: Start On-Demand Account Scan Initiates an on-demand security scan for the entire account, scanning all zones associated with the account. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/scans
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/scans
Initiates an on-demand security scan for the entire account, scanning all zones associated with the account. Rate limited to 5 scans per account per 24-hour window.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Updates Account State
description: Updates Account State Updates account-level Security Center state. PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/state
context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/state
Updates account-level Security Center state. Currently supports enabling or disabling scans for the account. Returns the account's state after the update.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Updates Security Center Insight Classification
description: Updates Security Center Insight Classification Updates the user classification for a Security Center insight. PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/{issue_id}/classification
context:
PATCH /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/security-center/insights/{issue_id}/classification
Updates the user classification for a Security Center insight. Valid values are 'false_positive' or 'accept_risk'. To reset, set classification to null. Cannot change directly between classification values - must reset to null first.
Required: account_id (path); issue_id (path); body (body)
